breakdown.description: Shallow-water wave speed c = sqrt(g h) applies only when h ≪ λ (e.g., h < λ/20). For deep water, wave speed depends on wavelength, not depth.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the user's provided formula, c = sqrt(g h), was for shallow-water waves and was inappropriate for the deep-water scenario described. It replaced the incorrect formula with the correct deep-water dispersion relation, c = sqrt(g λ / (2π)), which is exactly what the ground truth prompt specified.
